audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly assigns 'Personal Space' to E — it is her W (475-range shield, 16s); E is Looming Darkness (Gloom zone) and the dash-interrupting FEAR is her empowered PASSIVE, not W or E. Full layer merges shield and fear into one 'Personal Space (Fear)' object and has the recurring false 'W lock-on dive' for Naafiri. 14 misgender hits.
audit.why: Kit authority: P text 'empowered... next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes... whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark... reduces the cooldown of her empowered state' — so Naafiri's own dashes accelerate the fear schedule.
audit.corrected: Slots untangled where edited (passive = fear/interrupt, W = shield 16s), dash-feeds-her-cooldown stated, dive language moved to R, pronouns fixed.
